modules.title: Scour and seabed erosion at the berth
modules.summary: Whether the bed moves under current, waves and propeller wash, how deep scour develops at the piles and under the keel and how fast, how much pile embedment is exposed, and the rock size and tonnage that protects the bed.

criteria.label: Standard deviations added to the mean scour
criteria.help: The steady-current mean is 1.3 D with a standard deviation of 0.7 D; DNV-ST-0126 quotes 1.3 D as a default. Overridable default: confirm against the edition of the standard in force on the project.

criteria.label: Scour allowance in the pile design
criteria.help: Loss of bed level assumed in the strength and capacity checks of the piles.

criteria.label: Efflux velocity coefficient
criteria.help: V0 = c (P/(ρ Dp²))^(1/3). About 1.15 open and 1.17 ducted in PIANC WG180; ideal momentum theory gives 1.72 η^(1/3). Overridable default: confirm against the edition of the standard in force on the project.

criteria.label: Jet axis decay coefficient
criteria.help: V_axis = A V0 D0/x. 2.8 for a propeller jet (Blaauw & van de Kaa); 6.2 for a low-turbulence free jet; lower with a rudder splitting the jet.

criteria.label: Isbash coefficient for rock under the jet
criteria.help: D = U²/(2 g Δ C²). 0.86 exposed stone in ordinary turbulence, 1.2 embedded stone; propeller-jet guidance corresponds to about 0.55–0.7. Overridable default: confirm against the edition of the standard in force on the project.

criteria.label: Shear amplification at the pile
criteria.help: Bed shear stress next to the pile over the undisturbed value: about 4 in current, 2–4 in waves.

criteria.label: Share of the drawdown reaching the berth

criteria.label: Allowable inclination after damage
criteria.help: MODU Code column-stabilised units: 17° in any direction (with wind). Ships: 15° typical before cross-flooding. Confirm against the governing edition.

criteria.label: Required residual range of stability
criteria.help: Positive righting range beyond the damaged equilibrium (MODU Code: at least 7°).

criteria.label: Required opening height above the damaged waterline
criteria.help: MODU Code column-stabilised units: openings within 4 m above the final waterline must be watertight. Use 0 to require only that the opening stays dry.

criteria.label: Required residual maximum righting lever
criteria.help: Minimum residual GZ within the range (0.1 m is the SOLAS-type value).

criteria.label: Required survival index
criteria.help: Minimum probability-weighted share of the listed damage cases that must be survived (1.0 = every case, the deterministic MODU approach).

criteria.label: Threshold relative velocity (0 = Ochi 0.093·√(gL))
criteria.help: Re-entry velocity below which the impact is not counted as a slam.

criteria.label: Allowable pressure on the deck structure
criteria.help: Design lateral pressure of the exposed front wall or protection (green-water breakwater).

criteria.label: Allowable slamming pressure on the plating
criteria.help: Space-average impact pressure the local panel is designed for (from the local strength module or class rules).

criteria.label: Allowable slamming probability per wave cycle
criteria.help: Ochi & Motter operability criterion: 3 slams per 100 cycles.

criteria.label: Allowable deck-wetness probability per wave cycle
criteria.help: Customary seakeeping criterion: 5 wetnesses per 100 cycles (lower for manned areas).

criteria.label: Resonance band
criteria.help: Relative separation required between the sloshing period and the motion period (screening value, ±20 %).

criteria.help: Fraction of the as-built thickness that may be lost before renewal (class rules: typically 20 % for plating, less for strength-deck and bottom).

criteria.label: Inspections required within the growth period
criteria.help: The interval is the detectable-to-critical growth time divided by this factor, so that a crack is seen at least this many times before it becomes critical.

criteria.help: Lognormal with mean 1.0 on the stress range: 0.1–0.15 for refined analysis with monitoring, 0.2–0.3 for simplified load and stress models.

criteria.label: Target reliability index (accumulated)
criteria.help: Project target for the accumulated probability of a fatigue crack at the end of life (β = 2.3 ≈ 10⁻², 3.1 ≈ 10⁻³); higher for details that cannot be inspected or whose failure is critical.
